title: Polygonal Radiance Cascades
description_preview:
A new flavour of radiance cascades capable of producing aliasing-free light from a single pixel light source. You can play with its source in your browser:
https://radiance-cascades.github.io/LegitScriptEditor/?gh=Raikiri/LegitCascades/PolygonalHRC45.ls&rev=master
